verdicts.reason: A: the product photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail the same size as the logo, so the two compete side by side, and a large dead gap separates them from the body copy; the headline also breaks into a weak 'on' line. B: the bag is cut out at a more readable size but again sits next to an equal-weight logo, and the leftover blurred background photo has become a large, empty brown rectangle between the copy and the CTA. That block looks like a rendering error and wastes a third of the canvas, so A is only slightly less broken.
